mcp_tools.name: condition_monitoring_triage
mcp_tools.title: Condition monitoring triage
mcp_tools.description: Submit a condition-monitoring evidence manifest (baseline, monitoring/context/trending discipline, declared alert bands with readings, alarm triage record); get a deterministic TRIAGE_SOUND / TRIAGE_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed reading-vs-band classification and action-band triage checks, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The condition-monitoring evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and reading/alarm schemas).

baseline.description: Baseline evidence (exists, known load, post-repair capture).

trending.description: Trending evidence (deltas, rate of change, repair annotations).

readings.description: Declared readings: {parameter, value, watch_limit, warning_limit, action_limit}.

alarms.description: Alarm triage record: {id, disposition: noise|watch|act, reasoning_recorded, recheck_interval_set, work_request_raised}.

expect.notes: All boolean requirements met; readings within watch limits; escalation flags correctly set to false.
